target.approvedName: adaptor related protein complex 1 subunit sigma 3
functionDescriptions: Subunit of clathrin-associated adaptor protein complex 1 that plays a role in protein sorting in the late-Golgi/trans-Golgi network (TGN) and/or endosomes (PubMed:24791904, PubMed:36261523). The AP complexes mediate both the recruitment of clathrin to membranes and the recognition of sorting signals within the cytosolic tails of transmembrane cargo molecules (PubMed:24791904, PubMed:36261523). Involved in TLR3 trafficking (PubMed:24791904). .
